title: [PDF] FY 2027 President's Budget - Commodity Futures Trading Commission
summary: The CFTC submitted its FY 2027 budget request of $410 million (12.3% increase over FY 2026) to support regulatory oversight of derivatives markets amid rapid technological innovation including blockchain, crypto assets, smart contracts, and AI-driven trading systems. The budget prioritizes technology modernization, retail investor protection in derivatives markets, and core market integrity in agriculture and energy.
key_points: CFTC requests $410 million and 650 full-time equivalents for FY 2027, up $45 million (12.3%) from FY 2026 enacted level
Budget emphasizes need to regulate novel products and platforms including blockchain, crypto assets, and smart contracts
Agency identifies AI and autonomous trading systems as requiring oversight modernization
New retail-focused derivatives products have 'exploded in popularity' requiring new investor protection rules
Budget covers division-level requests: Enforcement, Market Oversight, Clearing and Risk, Market Participants, Data, and others
Agency commits to maintaining core agricultural and energy market oversight for hedging purposes
